room.title: Search
room.description: Find threads and messages in this room.
room.label: Keywords
room.start: Enter keywords or use the filters to find a thread.

hint: 3 or more characters match the start of a word; case and accents are ignored.

syntax.title: Build a precise search
syntax.description: Choose a format to insert it at the cursor. Combine any terms with spaces; every term must match.
syntax.hint: Matches whole words. Add a * for a prefix, or combine phrases and filters.
syntax.tip: Type a filter to see suggestions.

emoji.title: Emoji filters
emoji.description: Choose an exact reaction or an emoji contained in a message.
emoji.contains: Choose an emoji in a message

operators.prefix: Match words beginning with this prefix
operators.owner: Threads currently owned by this person
operators.during: Messages sent during a month or year

watching.label: Threads I watch
watching.hintOn: Only the threads you watch: type to narrow them.
watching.empty: You are not watching any threads.
watching.emptyQ: None of the threads you watch matches “{{q}}”.

watchingTagged.empty: None of the threads you watch carries these tags.
watchingTagged.emptyQ: None of the threads you watch with these tags matches “{{q}}”.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hintOn: Threads with any of these tags: type to narrow them.
tags.emptyQ: None of the threads with these tags matches “{{q}}”.

error.tooShort: Type at least two characters, with a letter or a digit.
error.invalid: The search cannot contain control characters.
error.structuredTooLong: Use at most 512 characters in a structured query.
error.structuredInvalid: Check the search syntax. Filters need a value, and emoji filters need an actual emoji.
error.timeout: The search took too long. Narrow it down with a more specific word.
error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.rate: Too many searches. Wait a moment and try again.
error.gone: This room no longer exists, or you are no longer a member of it.
